description: Exogenous data center electricity demand benchmarks for non-European regions (mission document §4.2: non-European regions enter only as exogenous parameters). Anchor points in TWh; the UI interpolates piecewise-linearly and must not extrapolate beyond the last anchor. 2024/2030 anchors follow the IEA 'Energy and AI' base case (US ≈45% and China ≈25% of global demand growth to 2030), corroborated for the US by LBNL and EPRI; 2035 anchors extend the IEA regional shares within the IEA global envelope and are marked expert-guess. EU-27 is NOT in this bundle — it is model output, shown against these benchmarks.
